title: VUA BDL warehouse command v0.1
description: Write commands over the local BDL warehouse (docs/protocols/bdl-commands-v0.1): the B4 artifact-mode trio. setArtifactMode sets or clears the per-entry artifact-mode override (null clears; resolution stays dynamic: override ?? global default). generateVpm and deleteOriginals submit audited maintenance tasks and return a task acceptance; their completion payloads travel the application-contract task surface, not this schema. The transport envelope (requestId, commandId, correlationId, taskId semantics) belongs to the application contract — this schema freezes the operation closed set and the params. Guards are server-side facts, never client assertions: generateVpm runs only in the generate_vpm effective mode with original material and no existing artifact; deleteOriginals only in the generate_vpm effective mode with a verified generated artifact.
